aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but misgroups the process change and misextracts key function and process outcomes.
issues: Changed factor should center on cutting/removal process improvement, not coating or dimension/spec.
Function NG values are parsed incorrectly; rows show total NG/rates around 36-39, not zero.
Vision/frame outcome rows 30-31 and 37 are omitted despite being core results.
Process before/after measurement uses only header evidence and questionable generated stats.
Final decision row 49 is omitted from evidence.
correctionPlan: Revise changeDomain to process condition only.
Define baseline/test conditions across normal, after cutting, and after array-by-hand change with row context.
Reparse function table using total NG and NG rate columns from rows 42-44.
Add separate outcomes for vision after cutting and frame after array using rows 28-31 and 35-37.
Cite decision row 49 and remove unsupported measurement statistics unless row-level data is available.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist, but current evidence is incomplete and some cited rows do not support extracted values.
